name: overcode
description: Extends AIDD with project-agnostic workflows: research and multi-session PDF extraction; interactive codebase and project-memory quizzes (dig); memory maintenance; repository-backed Markdown freshness with AIDD-routed code checks (taste); AIDD-routed document/code foresight plus dependency abandonment and migration horizon (foresee); behavioural testing; test governance; performance, data, ActivityPub, and SEO/GEO audits; project health and repository-backed Markdown backlog synchronization via status; plain-language explanations; documentation; and planning utilities. Stack and service knowledge remains pivot-driven through specialist plugins, and AIDD delegation fails explicitly when a required capability is unavailable. Alias chains: rechallenge, endtask, bump-plugin, previously, smarten, skillconf, weeklyemail, gitit, mirror, codex-vision.
